visual_identity.core_identity: A tall shaggy ambush predator of goblinoid stock, defined by long arms, heavy shoulders, and surprising stealth.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad upper body, very long arms hanging below the waist, slightly hunched posture, shaggy outline, powerful hands.
visual_identity.head_features: Heavy goblinoid face with broad nose, small deep-set eyes, pointed ears partly hidden by coarse hair.
visual_identity.body_shape: Tall muscular but not bodybuilder-thick humanoid with long reach, large hands and feet, and a forward-leaning ambush posture.
visual_identity.surface: Coarse shaggy fur concentrated on head, shoulders, forearms, and back with open uncluttered body areas.

accuracy_checks: arms are visibly longer than normal humanoid arms
body reads bugbear rather than ogre
fur is present but not over-rendered

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
